verses.sloka: ततः कुमुदषण्डाभो निर्मलम् निर्मलोदयः ।प्रजगाम नभश्चन्द्रो हंसो नीलमिवोदकम् ।। ५-१७- १।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumudaṣaṇḍābho nirmalam nirmalodayaḥ ।prajagāma nabhaścandro haṁso nīlamivodakam ।। 5-17- 1।।

translations.english: Then the Moon shining like a bed of lilies rose stainless, ascended the clear sky and looked like a swan swimming through blue water.
translations.hindi: उस समय कुमुद पुष्पों 'की तरह निर्मल चन्द्रमा निर्मल श्राकाश में, कुछ ऊपर चढ़, वैसे ही शोभित हुश्रा, जैसे नील जल वाली झील में हंस शोमित होता है

verses.sloka: साचिव्यमिव कुर्वन् स प्रभया निर्मलप्रभः ।चन्द्रमा रश्मभिः शीतैः सिषेवे पवनात्मजम् ।। ५-१७-२।।
verses.transliteration: sācivyamiva kurvan sa prabhayā nirmalaprabhaḥ ।candramā raśmabhiḥ śītaiḥ siṣeve pavanātmajam ।। 5-17-2।।

translations.english: The Moon shed clear lightas if with his brightness and his cool rays he wished to refresh the son of the Windgod.
translations.hindi: निमंल प्रभा वाले चन्द्रदेव, श्रपनी चाँदनी से हनुमानजी की सहायता करते हुए, उनको भ्रपनी शीतल किरणों से हर्षित करने लगे

verses.sloka: स ददर्श ततः सीताम् पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् ।शोकभारैरिव न्यस्तां भारैर्नावमिवाम्भसि ।। ५-१७-३।।
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ sītām pūrṇacandranibhānanām ।śokabhārairiva nyastāṁ bhārairnāvamivāmbhasi ।। 5-17-3।।

translations.english: Then he saw Sita whose face shone like the fullmoon. But she was as though sinking under the burden of sorrow, like a boat with heavy load sinking in water.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने चांदनी के सहारे चन्द्रमुखी सीता को देखा उस समय सीता की दशा मारे शोक के बंसी ही हो रही थी; जैसी कि, श्रधिक बोझ से लदी हुई नाव की जल में होती है

verses.sloka: दिदृक्षमाणो वैदेहीम् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।स ददर्शाविदूरस्था राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः ।। ५-१७-४।।
verses.transliteration: didṛkṣamāṇo vaidehīm hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।sa dadarśāvidūrasthā rākṣasīrghoradarśanāḥ ।। 5-17-4।।

translations.english: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.
translations.hindi: जानकी को देखते-देखते पवननन्दन हनुमानजी की दृष्टि उन भयङ्कर रूपों वाली राक्षसियों पर पड़ी जो सीताजी के समीप ही बैठी हुई थीं

verses.sloka: एकाक्षीमेककर्णाम् च कर्णप्रावरणाम् तथा ।अकर्णाम् शङ्कुकर्णाम् च मस्तकोच्छ्वासनासिकाम् ।। ५-१७-५।।
verses.transliteration: ekākṣīmekakarṇām ca karṇaprāvaraṇām tathā ।akarṇām śaṅkukarṇām ca mastakocchvāsanāsikām ।। 5-17-5।।

There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.

verses.transliteration: atikāyottamāṅgīṁ ca tanudīrghaśirodharām ।dhvastakeśīm tathākeśīm keśakambaladhāriṇīm ।। 5-17-6।।

verses.sloka: लम्बकर्णललाटाम् च लम्बोदरपयोधराम् ।लम्बोष्ठीं चुबुकोष्ठीं च लम्बास्याम् लम्बजानुकाम् ।। ५-१७-७।।
verses.transliteration: lambakarṇalalāṭām ca lambodarapayodharām ।lamboṣṭhīṁ cubukoṣṭhīṁ ca lambāsyām lambajānukām ।। 5-17-7।।

verses.transliteration: hrasvām dīrghām ca kubjām vikaṭām vāmanāṁ tathā ।karālām bhugnavaktrām ca piṅgākṣīm vikṛtānanām ।। 5-17-8।।

verses.sloka: विकृताः पिङ्गलाः कालीः क्रोधनाः कलहप्रियाः ।कालायसमहाशूलकूटमुद्गधारिणीः ।। ५-१७-९।।
verses.transliteration: vikṛtāḥ piṅgalāḥ kālīḥ krodhanāḥ kalahapriyāḥ ।kālāyasamahāśūlakūṭamudgadhāriṇīḥ ।। 5-17-9।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.

verses.sloka: वराहमृगशार्दूलमहिषाजशिवामुखीः ।गजोष्ट्र हयपादीश्च निखातशिरसोपराः ।। ५-१७-१०।।
verses.transliteration: varāhamṛgaśārdūlamahiṣājaśivāmukhīḥ ।gajoṣṭra hayapādīśca nikhātaśirasoparāḥ ।। 5-17-10।।

verses.transliteration: ekahastaikapādāśca kharakarṇyaśvakarṇikāḥ ।gokarṇīrhastikarṇīīśca harikarṇīstathāparāḥ ।। 5-17-11।।

Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
translations.hindi: फिसी का मुल घोडे जैसा, किसी का ऊंट जैसा आर किसी का गधे जैसा था । वे सब राक्षसी भयद्भुर रूपवाली थीं । उनके हाथों में शूल और मुद्गर थे तथा वे बड़ी गुस्सेल भौर झगड़ा करने वाली थीं

verses.sloka: कराळा धूम्रकेशीश्च राक्षसीर्विकृताननाः ।पिबन्तीः सततं पानं सदा मां ससुराप्रियाः ।। ५-१७-१६।।
verses.transliteration: karāḻā dhūmrakeśīśca rākṣasīrvikṛtānanāḥ ।pibantīḥ satataṁ pānaṁ sadā māṁ sasurāpriyāḥ ।। 5-17-16।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
translations.hindi: वे भयङ्कर औरौर धुएं के तुल्य केशवाली तथा भयङ्कर मुखों वाली राक्षसियाँ थीं । वे सदा शराब पिया करती थीं क्योंकि उनको शराब पीना श्रौर मांस खाना बहुत प्रिय लगता था

verses.sloka: मांसशोणितदिग्धाङ्गीर्मांसशोणितभोजनाः ।ता ददर्श कपिश्रेष्ठो रोमहर्षणदर्शनाः ।। ५-१७-१७।।
verses.transliteration: māṁsaśoṇitadigdhāṅgīrmāṁsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ ।tā dadarśa kapiśreṣṭho romaharṣaṇadarśanāḥ ।। 5-17-17।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
translations.hindi: उनके शरीर में मांस और रुविर सना हुआ था, क्योंकि वे रुचिर पीतीं श्रौर मांस खाया करती थीं । उनको देखने से देखने वाले के शरीर के रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते थे। एसी राक्षसियों को हनुमानजी ने वहाँ देखा

verses.sloka: स्कन्धवन्तमुपासीनाः परिवार्य वनस्पतिम् ।तस्याधस्ताच्च ताम् देवीम् राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम् ।। ५-१७-१८।।
verses.transliteration: skandhavantamupāsīnāḥ parivārya vanaspatim ।tasyādhastācca tām devīm rājaputrīmaninditām ।। 5-17-18।।

translations.english: The illustrious Hanuman watched the blameless princess Janaki who was seated under that tree.
translations.hindi: वे सब की सब, उस सघन वृक्ष को घेरे हुए थीं 'जिसके नीचे सुन्दरी राजपुत्री सीताजी बेठी हुई थीं

verses.sloka: लक्षयामास लक्ष्मीवान् हनुमान् जन्कात्मजाम् ।निष्प्रभाम् षोकसन्तप्ताम् मलसम्कुलमूर्धजाम् ।। ५-१७-१९।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣayāmāsa lakṣmīvān hanumān jankātmajām ।niṣprabhām ṣokasantaptām malasamkulamūrdhajām ।। 5-17-19।।

translations.english: Shorn of lustre, unkempt hair filled with dust, she appeared like a meteor slipped and fallen on land, merits exhausted.

verses.sloka: क्षीणपुण्याम् च्युताम् भूमौ ताराम् निपतितामिव ।चारित्रव्यपदेशाड्यां भर्तृदर्शनदुर्गताम् ।। ५-१७-२०।।
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇapuṇyām cyutām bhūmau tārām nipatitāmiva ।cāritravyapadeśāḍyāṁ bhartṛdarśanadurgatām ।। 5-17-20।।

translations.english: She was rich by her reputation for chastity but poor as she yearned to see her husband. Though devoid of all excellent ornaments, she looked adorned with love for her husband.
translations.hindi: चारित्रव्यपदेशाढयां-पतिब्रताघर्माचरणख्यातिसम्पन्नाम । (गो० ) मानो क्षीणपुण्य कोई तारा पृथिवी पर गिरा पड़ा है । सीताञ्जी एक प्रलिद्ध पतिव्रता स्त्री हे परन्तु इस समय इनको अपने पति का दर्शन दुलंभ ही रहा है

verses.sloka: भूषणैरुत्तमोर्हीनाम् भर्तृवात्सल्यभूषणाम् ।राक्षसाधिपसम्रुद्धाम् बन्धुभिश्च विना कृताम् ।। ५-१७-२१।।
verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇairuttamorhīnām bhartṛvātsalyabhūṣaṇām ।rākṣasādhipasamruddhām bandhubhiśca vinā kṛtām ।। 5-17-21।।

translations.english: Besieged by the demon king, deprived of her near and dear ones, Sita was looking like a fettered female elephant separated from its herd and besieged by lions.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि उनके अगों में बढ़िया गहने नहीं हे; तथापि वे पतिप्रेम रूपी भूषण से भूषित हैं और बन्धुजनों से रहित, वे रावण के यहाँ नजरबन्द हैं

verses.sloka: वियूथाम् सिम्हसम्रुद्धाम् बद्धाम् गजवधूमिव ।चन्द्ररेखाम् पयोदान्ते शारदाब्रैरिवावृताम् ।। ५-१७-२२।।
verses.transliteration: viyūthām simhasamruddhām baddhām gajavadhūmiva ।candrarekhām payodānte śāradābrairivāvṛtām ।। 5-17-22।।

translations.english: She appeared like a streak (crescent) of Moon covered by autumnal clouds at the close of the rainy season. She looked haggard since she was out of contact with her husband an unused lute with its strings let loose.
translations.hindi: उस समय जानकोजी एसी जान पड़ती थीं, मानो अपने झड से छुटी झौर बंधी हुई कोई हथिनी, सिंह के चंगुल में फंस गई हो । अथवा वर्षाऋतु के अन्त में मानो चन्द्र की चाँदनी शारदीय मेघों में छिप रही हो

verses.sloka: क्लिष्टरूपामसंस्पर्शादयुक्तामिव वल्लकीम् ।स ताम् भर्तवशे युक्तामयुक्ताम् राक्षसीवशे ।। ५-१७-२३।।
verses.transliteration: kliṣṭarūpāmasaṁsparśādayuktāmiva vallakīm ।sa tām bhartavaśe yuktāmayuktām rākṣasīvaśe ।। 5-17-23।।

translations.english: She deserves to be with Rama, but had fallen under the sway of shedemons. Sitting in the midst of Ashoka grove she was like a creeper without blossoms. Immersed in the ocean of sorrow the noble lady was like the star Rohini surrounded by unpropitious planets.
translations.hindi: उबटनादि न लगाने से, वे मानो बहुत दिनों से बिना बजाई बीणा की तरह मलिन हो रही हैँ । जो सीताजी अपने पति के पास रहने योग्य हैं वे आज राक्षसियों के कूरव टाक्ष की लक्ष्य बनी हुई हूँ भ्रथवा राक्षसियों के पहरे में हें

verses.sloka: अशोकवनिकामध्ये शोकसागरमाप्लुताम् ।ताभिः परिवृताम् तत्र सग्रहामिव रोहिणीम् ।। ५-१७-२४।।
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāmadhye śokasāgaramāplutām ।tābhiḥ parivṛtām tatra sagrahāmiva rohiṇīm ।। 5-17-24।।

translations.english: She deserves to be with Rama, but had fallen under the sway of shedemons. Sitting in the midst of Ashoka grove she was like a creeper without blossoms. Immersed in the ocean of sorrow the noble lady was like the star Rohini surrounded by unpropitious planets.
translations.hindi: प्रशोकवाटिका में सीता, मानो शोकसागर में डबती और उतराती ह अथवा मङ्गल ग्रह से ग्रसित रोहिणी की तरह, उन राक्षसियों से घिरी हुई हैं

verses.sloka: ददर्श हनुमान् देवीम् लतामकुसुमामिव ।सा मलेन च दिग्धाङ्गीवपुषा चाप्यलंकृता ।। ५-१७-२५।।
verses.transliteration: dadarśa hanumān devīm latāmakusumāmiva ।sā malena ca digdhāṅgīvapuṣā cāpyalaṁkṛtā ।। 5-17-25।।

translations.english: Even though she was daubed with dirt, and had no ornaments on her, she looked bright like a lotus fibre smeared with mud.

verses.sloka: मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति च न भाति च ।मलिनेन तु वस्त्रेण परिक्लिष्टेन भामिनीम् ।। ५-१७-२६।।
verses.transliteration: mṛṇālī paṅkadigdheva vibhāti ca na bhāti ca ।malinena tu vastreṇa parikliṣṭena bhāminīm ।। 5-17-26।।

translations.english: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.
translations.hindi: सुन्दर होने पर भो सीताजी कीचड़ में सनी हुई नलिनी की तरह शोभाहीन हो रही थीं । हनुमानज़ी ने देखा कि, मृगनयनी सीताजी अपने शरीर को एक जीण और मेले-कुचैले बस्त्र से ढेंके हुए हैं। यद्यपि सीताजी इस समय उदास थीं तथापि वे श्रोरामचन्द्र जी के बल पराक्रम का स्मरण कर, उदास नहीं जान पड़ती थीं

verses.sloka: संवृताम् मृगशाबाक्षीं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः ।ताम् देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा ।। ५-१७-२७।।
verses.transliteration: saṁvṛtām mṛgaśābākṣīṁ dadarśa hanumān kapiḥ ।tām devīṁ dīnavadanāmadīnāṁ bhartṛtejasā ।। 5-17-27।।

translations.english: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.

verses.sloka: रक्षिताम् स्वेन शीलेन सीतामसितलोचनाम् ।ताम् दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् सीताम् मृगशाबनिभेक्षणाम् ।मृगकन्यामिव त्रस्ताम् वीक्षमाणाम् समन्ततः ।। ५-१७-२८।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣitām svena śīlena sītāmasitalocanām ।tām dṛṣṭvā hanumān sītām mṛgaśābanibhekṣaṇām ।mṛgakanyāmiva trastām vīkṣamāṇām samantataḥ ।। 5-17-28।।

translations.english: Seeing the fawneyed Sita, a frightened female deer looking all around (as if for some help) sighing hot breath, was as though burning the trees having tender leaves with her hot sighs. She looked like a collective mass of all sorrows, a high tide of suffering.
translations.hindi: काले-काले नेत्रों वाली सीता जी अपने शील स्वभाव से स्वयं अपने वतिब्रत घर्मं की रक्षा कर रही थीं । उन मुगशावकनय्रनी सीताजी को हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: दहन्तीमिव निःश्वासैर्वृक्षान् पल्लवधारिणः ।सम्घातमिव शोकानाम् दुःखस्योर्मिमिवोथिताम् ।। ५-१७-२९।।
verses.transliteration: dahantīmiva niḥśvāsairvṛkṣān pallavadhāriṇaḥ ।samghātamiva śokānām duḥkhasyormimivothitām ।। 5-17-29।।

translations.english: Seeing the fawneyed Sita, a frightened female deer looking all around (as if for some help) sighing hot breath, was as though burning the trees having tender leaves with her hot sighs. She looked like a collective mass of all sorrows, a high tide of suffering.

verses.sloka: ताम् क्षमां सुविभक्ताङ्गीं विनाभरणशोभिनीम् ।प्रहर्षमतुलम् लेभे मारुतिः प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम् ।। ५-१७-३०।।
verses.transliteration: tām kṣamāṁ suvibhaktāṅgīṁ vinābharaṇaśobhinīm ।praharṣamatulam lebhe mārutiḥ prekṣya maithilīm ।। 5-17-30।।

translations.english: She was a tolerant lady. She had beautiful limbs which looked splendid even though she was not wearing ornaments. Hanuman experienced immeasurable joy on seeing Mythili.
translations.hindi: उस समय हनुमानजी को ऐसा जान पड़ा) मानो शोकसागर से दुःख- रूपी लहरें उठ रही हों । क्षमा की साक्षात्‌ मूर्ति, सुन्दर अङ्गो वाली तथा बिना आभूषणो के भी शोभायमान जानकीजी को देख, हनुमानजी बहुत प्रसन्न हुए । श्रेष्ठ नेत्रों वाली जानकीजी को देख, हनुमानजी श्रानन्द के श्राँसु बहाने लगे ग्रौर उन्होंने मनसा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को प्रणाम किया

verses.sloka: हर्षजानि च सोऽश्रूणि ताम् दृष्ट्वा मदिरेक्षणाम् ।मुमुचे हनुमांस्तत्र नमश्चक्रे च राघवम् ।। ५-१७-३१।।
verses.transliteration: harṣajāni ca so'śrūṇi tām dṛṣṭvā madirekṣaṇām ।mumuce hanumāṁstatra namaścakre ca rāghavam ।। 5-17-31।।

translations.english: Seeing that lady with eyes intoxicating, Hanuman shed tears of joy. At once he paid obeisance to Rama. (thinking he could trace Sita at last).

verses.sloka: नमस्कृत्वा रामाय लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान् ।सीतादर्शनसम्हृष्टो हनुमान् सम्वृतोऽभवत् ।। ५-१७-३२
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtvā rāmāya lakṣmaṇāya ca vīryavān ।sītādarśanasamhṛṣṭo hanumān samvṛto'bhavat ।। 5-17-32

translations.english: Heroic Hanuman felt happy when he saw Sita. He offered salutations to Rama and Lakshmana at heart and covered himself (with the leaves of the Simsupa tree) and waited. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
